exchanges: hi! ok so first some context, im on a break between meetings and need to vent a bit
Go ahead, I am listening.
so my mother in law fatima is staying with us for two weeks and she is lovely but she has taken over the living room tv completely, she watches Shetland every single evening
That is a lot of one show. Do you ever get the remote?
never lol. its fine, i mostly work in the evenings anyway after darya and kian go to bed
That makes sense. Evenings must be your focus time.
yeah the days are meetings and snacks. Wayfair keeps scheduling stuff at nap time
Nap-time meetings are the worst timing.
navid helps when he can, but on Monday he goes straight from work to the gym so im solo for dinner and bath
Solo bath nights are tiring. At least it is only one night.
true
How old are the kids now?
darya is four kian is almost two
Busy ages.
my best friend fatima, different fatima lol, just told me shes pregnant!!! due in April
That is wonderful news. You must be thrilled for her.
so thrilled. shes already exhausted though, she just lies on the couch rewatching Bridgerton
Rest is exactly what she needs right now.
ok meeting time, brb
Good luck.
back. oscar from my team spent the whole call practicing his Mandarin on our client in taipei
That is brave of him. How did the client take it?
they laughed a lot so i think it went ok
Sounds like it went well enough.
our cat Pashmak just knocked my coffee onto the rug
Oh no. Is the rug salvageable?
probably, its an old rug. pashmak is a menace
Cats do seem to know exactly what will cause the most trouble.
fun fact, pashmak means cotton candy in farsi. im Persian but i grew up in Winnipeg of all places
That is a sweet name for a cat. Those winters must have been something.
haha the winters were brutal
I can imagine.
oh and our neighbour grace told me this morning theyre moving to Calgary in the spring, im sad, the kids love her
That is a loss for the street. Will you stay in touch?
definitely. ugh wait i said monday for navid's gym thing, its Sunday now, he switched last month and i keep forgetting
Good to know. So the weeknights are a bit easier for you now.
they are, i just forget
Easy to mix up.
i also finally bought a treadmill for under my desk, its been three days and ive walked like 20 km during meetings
That is impressive. Has anyone noticed on calls?
nobody has said anything yet lol
Then keep walking.
wait which show is my mother in law obsessed with again
darya just came home from Maplewood with paint in her hair, the preschool did a messy art day
Sounds like she had a great day.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your mother-in-law Fatima has been watching Shetland every evening.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your mother-in-law Fatima has been watching Bridgerton every evening.
